# … 添 · *… tim1*

**Meaning:** too; as well; even (adding one more thing) · **Level:** B1 · **Topic:** Sentence-final particles

> **Draft: awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Ftim1-as-well).

添 at the end of a sentence adds one more thing, often with feeling: something extra, or one more piece of bad luck. It often goes with 仲 (even) or 多 (more): 飲多杯添 means "have another glass".

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **佢今晚仲要加班添。** |
| Jyutping | keoi5 gam1 maan5 zung6 jiu3 gaa1 baan1 tim1. |
| Yale | kéuih gām máahn juhng yiu gā bāan tīm. |
| Bopomofo | ㄎㆤㄧ⁵ ㄍㄜㆬ¹ ㄇㄚㄣ⁵ ㄗㄨㄥ⁶ ㄧㄨ³ ㄍㄚ¹ ㄅㄚㄣ¹ ㄊㄧㆬ¹. |
| English | And she even has to work overtime tonight. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我唔記得帶遮添！** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1 tim1! |
| Yale | ngóh m̀h gei dāk daai jē tīm! |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㆬ⁴ ㄍㄝㄧ³ ㄉㄜㆶ¹ ㄉㄚㄧ³ ㄗㄝ¹ ㄊㄧㆬ¹! |
| English | And I forgot my umbrella too! |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **飲多杯添啦。** |
| Jyutping | jam2 do1 bui1 tim1 laa1. |
| Yale | yám dō būi tīm lā. |
| Bopomofo | ㄧㄜㆬ² ㄉㄛ¹ ㄅㄨㄧ¹ ㄊㄧㆬ¹ ㄌㄚ¹. |
| English | Have another glass. |
